### 1. Scene
A breakfast/brunch plate with scrambled eggs, sausage, roasted potatoes, fresh fruit, and leafy salad.

### 2. Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, partly cropped. I estimate an equivalent circular diameter of **27 cm**, giving an area of **3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm²**.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The salad appears lightly dressed. Dressing is estimated separately; cooking fat is included in the calorie densities of the cooked foods.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roasted potatoes | 23% | 132 cm² × 1.8 cm = 238 ml | 0.65 | 155 g | 150 | 233 kcal |
| Pineapple chunks | 14% | 80 cm² × 1.8 cm = 144 ml | 0.65 | 94 g | 50 | 47 kcal |
| Strawberry pieces | 6% | 34 cm² × 1.4 cm = 48 ml | 0.60 | 29 g | 32 | 9 kcal |
| Scrambled eggs | 12% | 69 cm² × 1.1 cm = 76 ml | 0.95 | 72 g | 180 | 130 kcal |
| Sausage | 6% | 34 cm² × 1.5 cm = 51 ml | 0.95 | 49 g | 300 | 147 kcal |
| Mixed leafy salad, including spinach and carrot slivers | 25% | 143 cm² × 2 cm = 286 ml | 0.13 | 37 g | 25 | 9 kcal |
| Light dressing | Overlay* | 143 cm² × 0.035 cm ≈ 5 ml | 1.0 | 5 g | 450 | 23 kcal |

*The dressing coats the salad, so it adds no separate plate footprint. The food areas sum to **86%**, consistent with the plate being mostly covered.*

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **541 g and approximately 598 kcal**. That is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate: potatoes and fruit supply much of the weight, while eggs and sausage supply much of the energy. The loose greens account for only 37 g.
